name: Woodland Cover
body:
You are skilled at using features of the forest to provide yourself cover.

Prerequisite: Favored Terrain (forest) class ability

Benefit: When fighting in a forest environment, you have constant partial cover against ranged attacks. You may not benefit from this feat if you are helpless or flat-footed.
